primaryChecks.text: So she went, and came to the man of God to Mount Carmel. When the man of God saw her afar off, he said to Gehazi his servant, “Behold, there is the Shunammite.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Then she saddled a donkey, and said to her servant, “Drive, and go forward! Don’t slow down for me, unless I ask you to.”
primaryChecks.nextContext: Please run now to meet her, and ask her, ‘Is it well with you? Is it well with your husband? Is it well with your child?’” She answered, “It is well.”
primaryChecks.decisionJa: ベエル・シェバが「ダンから」の南端として直接明記される。

primaryChecks.text: They said to him, “Hezekiah says, ‘Today is a day of trouble, of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children have come to the point of birth, and there is no strength to deliver them.
primaryChecks.previousContext: He sent Eliakim, who was over the household, Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
primaryChecks.nextContext: It may be the LORD your God will hear all the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the living God, and will rebuke the words which the LORD your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’”
primaryChecks.decisionJa: エリヤがベエル・シェバに着き、従者を残したことが直接記される。後出事実としてゲートする。

wikipediaRead.title: ベエルシェバ
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 記事はベエルシェバを南部の現代都市と説明し、聖書地名と「ダンから」の表現に言及する。歴史節は聖書のベエルシェバ遺跡を現代市街東側のテル・ベエルシェバと区別する。
